title: Product analytics track
content: The product analytics track is for beginners and junior specialists who want to move into analytics roles. It focuses on metrics, SQL basics, dashboards, interviews, and a portfolio project. Recommended start: this month or within 1-2 months.

title: Digital design track
content: The digital design track helps students build a portfolio for UX/UI or product design roles. It fits career changers, freelancers, and marketing specialists who need a structured path and mentor feedback.

title: Group format
content: Group format is best for students who want a fixed schedule, peer accountability, and regular mentor sessions. Admissions managers should clarify start date and weekly availability.

title: Consultation format
content: Consultation format is best when the student already knows the direction and needs a quick fit check, portfolio review, or career plan. It is often a warm lead unless the student wants to start within 7 days.

title: Budget readiness
content: Budget readiness is a strong lead signal. If the student says they are ready to discuss payment or choose a format this week, route to manager quickly. If they only ask for prices and are unsure about timing, nurture first.

title: Follow-up policy
content: Hot leads should be contacted as soon as possible. Warm leads should receive fit questions the same day. Cold leads should receive useful intro material and a reminder later, without blocking the manager queue.
